subject: Adaptive compliance bundle proposal and evidence-delivery cadence
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@healthexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Adaptive compliance bundle — draft and evidence-delivery cadence

Hi Marie,

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, attached is a first-pass proposal for a modular "Adaptive Compliance" bundle tailored to Healthexa: audit-log retention tiers, KMS/HSM seat vs metered compute pricing, and an EU on‑prem residency path for production traffic. The PDF includes three packaging options (Pilot, Scale, Enterprise) and an evidence-delivery cadence tied to onboarding milestones.

Two things I want to call out up front:
- We can offer a 6‑month pilot price with waived implementation fees if you commit to a 12‑month reserved capacity at pilot conversion.
- For HSM, customers often prefer a hybrid: one HSM seat (hardware-backed keys) plus metered KMS calls for bulk operations. We priced both variants so you can compare unit economics.

Please review the SOW draft and the timeline spreadsheet I attached. If you have procurement constraints (PO timing, EU legal signoffs), flag them and we can align Ben and Jonas on alternative crediting paths.

Next steps: if the packaging looks close, can we set a short call Wed 10/6 to walk the economics? If you prefer, I can send a one‑page matrix that maps typical Healthexa volumes to expected monthly cost.

Attachments: adaptive-compliance-bundle-v1.pdf (proposal), SOW-draft-healthexa.docx, evidence-delivery-timeline.xlsx

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@healthexa.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Adaptive compliance bundle — draft and evidence-delivery cadence

Sofia — thanks, received. Quick clarifying items before we loop procurement:

1) HSM seat vs metered KMS: our security team is leaning toward a seat-based model but they want a clear view on how key rotation and emergency key export would be handled in the hybrid approach.
2) Audit logs: can you confirm whether the audit log ingestion price includes indexing for e‑discovery? That is a line item for us.
3) Evidence delivery: our legal team will require signed timestamps for each evidence package delivery — is that supported?

We have a procurement freeze the week of 10/11 but can likely move a PO the week of 10/18. We prefer an initial 3‑month pilot with the option to convert.

Can Ben or Jonas provide the cost delta if we replace the single HSM seat with a full-seat cluster (3 seats) in the Enterprise packaging? That will drive our internal security signoff.

Thanks — Marie
Marie Dubois
Head of Compliance, Healthexa
marie.dubois@healthexa.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Adaptive compliance bundle — pricing asks from Healthexa

Sofia — forwarding Marie's questions. My quick read:

- Key rotation / emergency export: the hybrid model supports automated rotation via KMS APIs; the HSM seat supports attestation and key-escrow under our support SLA. We should document the process in the SOW appendix.
- Audit log indexing: indexing for e-discovery is an add-on (compute + retention). We can toggle a "search indexing" flag per retention tier.
- Signed timestamps: we can provide verifiable timestamps (RFC 3161 style) as part of the evidence bundle — that'll be a small engineering ops fee to automate.

Pricing options I recommend we present:
1) Seat-first (Enterprise): 3 HSM seats, audit log retention 5 years, full indexing — list price + 12% concession
2) Hybrid (Pilot/Scale): 1 HSM seat + metered KMS for calls, audit logs 1 year retention w/ optional indexing — 8% concession if they commit to 12 months after pilot
3) Metered-only: no HSM seats, metered KMS and audit retention as needed — baseline per-call economics with volume tiers

Action: Jonas + Karthik, can you run a quick model for a Healthexa pilot sized 50k calls/day, 1 TB of logs/month, and the Enterprise 3-seat scenario? We need delta numbers to share on Wed call.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@healthexa.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:16:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Adaptive compliance bundle — pricing asks from Healthexa

Marie / Sofia — thanks for the questions. Attached is a quick economics snapshot (I will also upload the full model to the shared Drive). Highlights:

- Pilot (50k KMS calls/day, 1 TB logs/month):
  • Hybrid option: estimated monthly bill = EUR 12,200 (includes 1 HSM seat amortized + metered KMS + 1 year audit retention no indexing)
  • Metered-only: estimated monthly bill = EUR 9,500 (no HSM seat)
- Enterprise (3 HSM seats, 5y retention + indexing): estimated monthly bill = EUR 42,000 (seat amortization + indexing compute + premium support)

Cost deltas and recommended concessions: a 10% one-time conversion credit at pilot->scale helps close; for Enterprise up-front commit we can offer a 14% concession across the bundle (amortize implementation fee over 12 months).

On evidence: we can provide signed timestamps and a secure evidence drop (SFTP or signed Drive links) per milestone. We should confirm whether Healthexa requires HSM-held signing keys for evidence (adds complexity).

I'll join Wed 10/6 to walk the model — suggest we build two short slides: cost breakdown and conversion pathway.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Architect
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@healthexa.com>, Healthexa Procurement <procurement@healthexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Adaptive compliance bundle — pricing asks from Healthexa

Marie — thanks for the quick turnaround and the procurement timing note. Two concrete asks and proposed commitments below:

1) HSM cluster delta: Jonas' attached snapshot shows the 3-seat cluster delta to Enterprise. If Healthexa prefers a stronger security posture, we will price the cluster explicitly and provide the key rotation and emergency export flow in the SOW appendix.

2) Evidence and timestamps: we will include RFC3161-compatible signed timestamps for each evidence package as part of the Enterprise and Scale packages. For Pilot we will deliver signed evidence manually (SFTP with signed manifest) and can add automation on conversion. There will be a one‑time automation engineering fee of EUR 3,500 if you want automated signed timestamps during the pilot.

Proposal (clean ask):
- Pilot: 3 months, Hybrid pricing (1 HSM seat + metered KMS), 1 year audit retention (no indexing), no implementation fee if PO placed by 2026-10-18.
- Conversion credit: 10% one-time credit off first 3 months after conversion to 12m reserved capacity.
- Enterprise: 3-seat HSM cluster, 5 year retention + indexing, 14% concession with 12‑month commit.

If that works for Healthexa, we can circulate a redlined SOW and a short one‑pager for procurement today. Can you confirm PO timing and whether the procurement team needs a specific invoice cadence?

Thanks — and happy to hop on a call if you prefer a quick review before circulating the redline.

Best,
Sofia
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: adaptive-compliance-bundle-v1.pdf; SOW-draft-healthexa.docx; evidence-delivery-timeline.xlsx
